name: Agnimukh Loh

sections.introduction: Agnimukh Loha is an Ayurvedic herbal formulation which is considered as the best remedy for Arsh (Hemorrhoids), anti-anemic, anti-inflammatory, and good for skin disorders and acts as good appetizer.
sections.ingredients:
Triphala Powder: This is prepared by mixing equal parts of Amalaki ( Emblica officinalis ), Haritaki ( Terminalia chebula ), Bibhitaki ( Terminalia bellrica ). It pacifies all three doshas. This rasayan is effective in all disorders. 
 Chitrak Mool (Root extract of Plumbago zeylanica) – 375 grams: Due to pungent and hot properties, it acts as an appetizer and digestant. It is useful in indigestion, anorexia, abdominal pain. 
 Pippali (Piper longum) – 46 grams: It promotes digestive fire and has rejuvenating property. It pacifies Vata and Kapha. It is effective in indigestion, diarrhea, gastric problems and stomach pain. 

 Other Ingredients Are: 

 Trivrut ( Operculina turpethum ) – 375 grams 
 Sindubaarpatra (Leaves Extract of Vitex negundo ) – 375 grams 
 Snuhi ( Euphorbia neriifolia ) – 375 grams 
 Mundi ( Sphaeranthus indicus ) – 375 grams 
 Bhumi Amla ( Phyllanthus niruri ) – 375 grams 
 Sudh Shilajeet (Purified Asphaltum) – 46 grams 
 Teekshan Loh Bhasam (Fine ash of Purified Iron) – 550 grams 
 Goughrita (Cow’s Ghee) – 1100 grams 
 Madhu (Honey) – 550 grams 
 Shakkar (Sugar) – 550 grams 
 Vaividang ( Embilia ribes ) – 140 grams 

 Method of Preparation 

 Take a big copper utensil and add drugs from first six drugs in the list from trivrut upto bhumiamla and make their decoction accordingly. 
 Then take another flask of steel & add gaughrit to it & add the loh bhasma to it. Then mix the sugar in decoction of trivrut etc. drugs and cook it in low flame. When it is ready add Vidang, trikatu & triphala churana & sudh shilajatu in it & then mix it homogenously. 
 After cooling add honey to it & mix it & make tablets from it. 


 Medicinal Properties 
 Agnimukh loh is as already mentioned best medicine for Arsh as it is beneficial in treating the mandagni (reduced digestive power) as mandagni is considered as basic cause of it. The drugs of trikatu (i.e. sunthi, marich pippli) are the basic reason for treating mandagni. Also by consuming this medicine regularly, it also proves too beneficial in digesting stones within body. 
 Apart from these it has good role in rheumatoid arthritis due to its anti-inflammatory, analgesic improving digestion etc. properties. It is also written in texts that there is no disease in this Earth which is cured by this drug named “Agnimukh Loh”.

sections.dose:
Two tablets twice daily with plain water after meals. Can be consumed up to 1-2 grams in a day. 
 Cautions 

 Take under medical supervision. 


 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
